summary: AS-IS Discard builds IDiscardHand(cardSource, hashtable) carrying {"CardEffect":_cardEffect} per-card (:709/:729); TO-BE drops the hashtable entirely and instead threads causeId/_cardEffect only at the IDiscardHands(list, causeId, _cardEffect) call level (:213/:228/:284) — cannot confirm equivalence without the IDiscardHand ctor, a different data-flow shape. Also RunAsIsSelectionAsync's ChoiceRequest minCount=(_canNoSelect||_canEndNotMax)?0:maxCount collapses AS-IS's separate "No Selection" button path (only reachable at PreSelectedHandCards.Count==0, CanEndSelect :578 requires count==maxCount unless canEndNotMax) into one min/max range, permitting selections between 0 and maxCount that AS-IS's CanEndSelect would reject when canNoSelect=true and canEndNotMax=false.

DecodeProcess's final PlayPermanentCards call: AS-IS passes activateClass: activateClass (the live ICardEffect, TrashDigivolutionCards.cs/CardEffectCommons.cs:23 signature `ICardEffect activateClass`) but TO-BE calls a DIFFERENT overload with sourceCard: cardSource (confirmed two distinct PlayPermanentCards overloads exist in the mirror CardEffectCommons.cs at :1795 and :4935) — the cause/activateClass object threaded into the play is swapped for the raw CardSource, not a substrate rename.
